headline: The 33.45 s/step co-resident figure is memory-forced, not a configuration mistake: with distributed layerwise offload disabled all eight ranks run out of NPU memory by only a few hundred MiB, so the offload is what makes the live encoder fit. The stack is about 0.2-0.5 GiB per rank short of full residency.
why_this_round: Round 116 measured 33.45 s/step with the text encoder live against 14.657 s/step for the DiT-only figure, a 2.28x gap. The obvious hypothesis was that enable_distributed_layerwise_offload was thrashing and could simply be switched off. This round tested that hypothesis directly instead of assuming it.

experiment.design: single-variable A/B on the same live-encoder 49-step request at the goal's baseline (1344x768, 5 s, 24 fps, 124 frames, seed 1234, fl2va, USP8, official undistilled 50-block model in FP16), changing only enable_distributed_layerwise_offload

arm_B_offload_off.outcome: FAILED - NPU out of memory on all 8 ranks

experiment.module_overrides_same_in_both_arms: dtype=half, ulysses_degree=8, ring_degree=1, text_encoder_tp_size=8, vae_parallel_mode=tile, vae_use_tiling=True, vae_patch_parallel_size=8, model_loaded={transformer,vae,text_encoder,vae_encoder}=True

out_of_memory_evidence.reserved_vs_allocated: 31.80 GiB reserved against 31.65 GiB allocated, so fragmentation is not the dominant term

conclusions: Layerwise offload is load-bearing: without it the encoder, DiT and VAE cannot be simultaneously resident at this request shape on 8x32 GiB.
Therefore the 2.28x per-step penalty is the measured price of the offload that memory forces, not a gratuitous setting that could be flipped off for free.
The shortfall is small - a few hundred MiB per rank, under 1.5% of capacity - so a modest reduction in resident or intermediate memory is the difference between co-resident and offloaded.

This gives the self-developed fused-op work a concrete, measurable target it previously lacked: fusing RMSNorm/AddRMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE and AdaLN removes intermediate tensors and their buffers, so it can be judged by whether it closes this specific gap.

staged.how: encode the prompt first, release the encoder, then denoise with the DiT and VAE resident
staged.evidence: round 76 measured this mode: text_encoder=False with conditioning computed beforehand, 14.657 s/step, all 49 steps under 15 s, 735.689 s wall excluding the live encoder
staged.composition: 735.689467 s (round 76 measured request wall excluding the live encoder; also verified: 14.657157 s/step mean of rank maxima and all 49 steps below 15 s) + 1.3212001398 s (round 108 median of five samples, each the 8-rank maximum, for the true Vision-block TP8 plus native-text TP8 encoder; the five samples were 1.311685 / 1.243577 / 1.322445 / 1.364717 / 1.321200 s, all under 2 s)
staged.status: COMPOSED FROM TWO SEPARATE MEASUREMENTS, not a single run; labelled as such deliberately

co_resident.how: encoder, DiT and VAE all loaded in one engine

two_legitimate_operating_modes.which_is_the_fair_comparison: Production serves prompts by encoding then denoising; the co-resident mode exists here only because the memory budget is too tight. The staged mode is the honest comparable basis, and it must be stated as a composed figure until a single staged run is performed.

caveats: A2/A3 are the official full-schedule release on different hardware
A2/A3 report T2VA; this workload is FL2VA
the staged figure is composed from two measurements rather than one run
these are directional ratios, not an apples-to-apples speed claim

not_claimed: no single-run staged end-to-end measurement yet
next: Run the staged mode end to end in one process to replace the composed 737 s with a single measurement: encode, release the encoder, denoise 49 steps, decode VAE, all timed in one engine.
Quantify the VAE decode share of the 472 s that round 116 measured outside the denoise loop, since the goal's item (3) asks for decode within 20 s.
Attack the few-hundred-MiB shortfall with the fused-op work and re-test full residency, which is the only path that removes the offload penalty without giving up the live encoder.
